text: Curated transactions are clean and current, but nobody in Operations queries a transaction table directly. This video builds the two gold models they actually use.

daily_sales_gold rolls curated up to one row per store per day. inventory_depletion_gold goes further, using a window function to compute each store-SKU pair's trailing 7-day sell-through rate -- a smoothed trend, not one noisy day.
That function partitions by store and SKU, averaging the last seven days on every row -- exactly the rate a manager watching a shelf actually wants.
Both models are triggered by an Airflow DAG running dbt run and then dbt test as separate steps, scheduled for 6:15 each morning -- no one has to remember to run this by hand.
The stockout report that took two days now rebuilds itself automatically from data that's minutes old. Next: putting these tables in front of the people who asked for them.
